output.brief:
The August drop is mostly a cooling failure, not the contractor, the kiosks, the survey, or the rate rise. The chiller serving floors 6-8 failed 4-19 August and the rooms ran hot (26.5-29 C against a 22 C set point). Scores on those floors fell 8.6 to 7.4 and recovered to 8.4 once the part was fitted. Floors 1-5 barely moved, and cleanliness, check-in, and inspection pass rates were flat. Heat complaints account for most negative comments.

I am fairly confident in the cooling finding. Rate and value-score effects are less clear. The next responsible steps: reinstate the deferred maintenance on both chillers (CH-1 is the same age and also overdue), keep a spare contactor on site, and set a cooling-outage guest recovery protocol. Do not serve notice on Orrin or pull the kiosks on this evidence. Do not drop the August floor 6-8 responses from the bonus score. Revisit the rate question separately if value scores stay low.
